playerFlow.prerequisite: Cyberpunk 2077 plus official REDmod support installed for the player's platform/store
playerFlow.firstInstall: close game; copy the release contents to the Cyberpunk 2077 root so mods/Biology lands intact; enable REDmod-compatible mods through the supported launcher/store flow; allow REDmod deployment to complete
playerFlow.normalLaunch: Steam / supported normal Cyberpunk launch after REDmod is enabled
playerFlow.update: close game; remove/replace only Biology-owned paths identified by the installed owner manifest; install the newer release; redeploy through the supported REDmod flow when package content changed
playerFlow.disable: disable REDmod-compatible mods through the supported launcher/store flow; do not treat this as uninstall or destructive save-state reset
playerFlow.uninstall: close game; remove only paths listed by the installed Biology owner manifest; never delete broad shared framework or game directories

ownerManifest.rule: Every file installed by a Biology release must be listed exactly once. Uninstall removes listed files and then empty Biology-owned directories only; broad directory deletion is forbidden.

conditionalSupplementalRoots.condition: Only while manifest/dependency-graph.json retains redscript and the integrated runtime manifest names the exact first-party files.
Only exact pinned redscript dependency files if redscript remains and redistribution is approved. Never treat the directory itself as Biology-owned.
Only exact pinned redscript dependency files if required. Never replace/delete unrelated shared files during uninstall.

cleanRoom.reason: REDmod package/dependency architecture is a structural change from the pre-refactor baseline.

rules: The repository root is not a player package.
mods/Biology is the authoritative first-party REDmod namespace.
Shared framework roots are never deleted wholesale, even when a dependency is bundled by a future integrated release.
If the installed owner manifest is missing or hashes/collisions cannot be accounted for, iteration testing fails closed and escalates to the documented milestone clean-room procedure.
The foundation artifact is not a public playable release and does not claim to install the full runtime yet.
